model.basis: [1], [1,u,v], or [1,u,v,u^2,u*v,v^2]; u,v are normalized zero-based column,row indices spanning[-1,1].
model.estimator: Least squares initialization; Huber IRLS weights min(1,threshold/abs(residual)), unit weight at zero; explicit field-unit threshold.
model.condition: Infinity-norm condition of the last solved weighted normal matrix, not of the design matrix. No ridge or automatic regularization.
model.convergence: Maximum predicted surface change across originally valid source cells <=explicit absolute field-unit tolerance; no artifacts on iteration exhaustion.

assumptions: Polynomial degree, estimator, training exclusions and threshold are explicit choices; broad geology can enter the regional and residuals are not uniquely geological. No automatic noise scale or filter selection.

All originally valid cells retain regional predictions and residual=source-regional, including exclusions. Exclusions remove fitting influence, not subtraction. Missing original cells stay missing in all artifacts.

Source-footprint policy permits prediction away from training. Reported training index bounds are not a convex hull or local-support guarantee; gaps/excluded regions can yield unsupported extrapolation.
Conditioning is checked for the weighted normal equations. Huber convergence/threshold and conditioning gates do not establish geological correctness or statistical confidence.
Huber-downweighted training counts are algorithmic residual diagnostics, not labels of erroneous data. Source uncertainty/history remains archived without propagation.
Source field_type/units are preserved for regional/residual; raw fields never become corrected anomalies implicitly. Training mask is other/1.
Budgeted fit work=(training_cells*terms^2+valid_cells*terms)*(1+Huber iteration limit, or1 for least squares). No random subsampling, implicit I/O or optional numerical backend.
